features.featureTitle: In the Resources page (`frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx`), connect the following four downloadable/external resource items to their respective URLs, opening each link in a new tab. The items and their URLs are: (1) वैदिक दर्शन का परिचय → https://share.google/ofFQSRZ1FTsdJB8Op; (2) दैनिक प्रार्थना संग्रह → https://adipurgroup.wordpress.com/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/e0a4b8e0a4ade0a4be.pdf; (3) त्योहार कैलेंडर और अनुष्ठान → https://calendarhindu.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/12/Hindu-Calendar-2026-With-Tithi-in-Hindi-PDF-Download.pdf; (4) भगवद गीता अध्ययन मार्गदर्शिका → https://www.rupanugabhajanashram.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/11/Bhagavad-Gita-Hindi.pdf. Each link must use `target="_blank"` and `rel="noopener noreferrer"`.
